evidence.summary: 独立CLI/MCP工具平台，用项目内任务、Agent/模型登记、provider调用与状态记录辅助多Agent开发协调。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、bin/cli.js、package.json、plugins/ruflo-mods/hooks/register.ts、plugins/ruflo-mods/hooks/route/index.ts、plugins/ruflo-mods/hooks/route/route-task.ts、v3/@claude-flow/cli/bin/cli.js、v3/@claude-flow/cli/package.json、v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/mcp-client.ts、v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/mcp-tools/agent-execute-core.ts、v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/mcp-tools/agent-tools.ts、v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/mcp-tools/swarm-tools.ts、v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/mcp-tools/task-tools.ts、v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/services/policy-runtime.ts、v3/@claude-flow/security/src/mcp-caller-identity.ts、v3/@claude-flow/security/src/policy/engine.ts、v3/@claude-flow/security/src/policy/evaluator.ts；stdio→全registry与中央policy→handler；agent_spawn登记，agent_execute直接provider文本请求/回退/归档，task操作另外改JSON状态。见[Q02](#research-q02)。
limitations: 根/v3包与bin stdio、MCP registry/调用/中央policy代表模式与身份开关、agent_spawn/execute provider选路/Anthropic单次请求/有条件回退/反馈/归档、task assign/complete/cancel、Agent terminate/health、swarm孤儿/写入和pheromone锁caller、Claude mod路由注册/静态提示。只核与采用直接相关代表链；未全审已构建发行字节/全部provider与native工作/工具循环、workflow/安全/授权/成本规则、neural/训练/memory/federation/console/各客户端实现；未执行目标。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 为已有协调需求的开发者统一角色/模型、任务和调用结果记录；根为CLI/MCP工具，非DSH插件，登记不是自主工作。见[Q01](#research-q01)。
stdio→全registry与中央policy→handler；agent_spawn登记，agent_execute直接provider文本请求/回退/归档，task操作另外改JSON状态。见[Q02](#research-q02)。

根/v3包与bin stdio、MCP registry/调用/中央policy代表模式与身份开关、agent_spawn/execute provider选路/Anthropic单次请求/有条件回退/反馈/归档、task assign/complete/cancel、Agent terminate/health、swarm孤儿/写入和pheromone锁caller、Claude mod路由注册/静态提示。只核与采用直接相关代表链；未全审已构建发行字节/全部provider与native工作/工具循环、workflow/安全/授权/成本规则、neural/训练/memory/federation/console/各客户端实现；未执行目标。
仓库Ruflo，根npm名claude-flow 3.63.8、MIT、Node>=20；bin转v3 CLI同版再导入dist，stdio serverInfo代码另有3.0.0常量不作发行版。存在客户端专用插件但根不是DSH插件；未验证npm别名/发行/安装或所有原生mods。
构建/依赖、每轮模型与可能embedding/切模型、人工分配/合并/独立验收及多JSON恢复分开；timeout/输出数不是全任务费用上限，缓存折扣和净工时未测。表见[Q05](#research-q05)。

先观察，已有明确协调需求者最多在后续独立账户/隔离非敏感副本、匹配实际dist、私有受控stdio中核一项代表操作，并显式model/provider、小正有限输出和零fallback，不全开mods/neural/federation。分别核登记、API/stopReason、真实产物/测试和多文件状态，schema剪裁不当授权，task/agent stop不当请求/进程/外部动作撤回。身份、root、回执、费用或退出不清即停并人工读回，不能用本次单次文本接口承诺自主代码执行或生产多租户交付。见[Q05](#research-q05)。
源码支持真实协调/文本调用与部分恢复/授权措施，不证明自主工作、任务质量/全局学习增益或更便宜；状态/API/验收分开。效果表见[Q05](#research-q05)。
可借鉴先中央policy再handler、结果重读保新修改、scope化API观测与部分锁/原子写；应明确广告/授权、API/质量和状态/物理退出，不能用局部机制概括全系统。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。
统一协调操作和单次模型调用/观测，具局部重读、孤儿/锁及中央policy接线；不以角色数/演示/弱标签算自主交付或学习收益。见[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q04](#research-q04)。
本路径agent_execute是单次文本API而非工具结果回灌循环；task completed/API success不能验代码。多JSON/状态stop非事务/物理退出，schema剪裁只管广告；policy legacy/observe与enforce分开。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。
先复用/检查现有quality hook，以独立产物验收分开API弱反馈，并把登记/请求/工作退出分层；简单原生Task/人工清单或小修够用就否定新编排产品。见[Q06](#research-q06)。
匹配实际构建/Node、私有MCP/正确root与JSON写权限、真实provider/模型/额度必需；policy模式/身份和客户端特性另核，neural/mods等可选不全开。表见[Q05](#research-q05)。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)成熟MCP/状态/provider接线的组合novelty9，未到清晰新方法差异18；[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)重读/回退/部分锁和中央policy实际机制15，超薄接口8，但非自主产物/全生命周期正确性23；广告/权限、API/质量及局部并发规则可迁移10，超仅本项目经验5，仍强耦合客户端/状态未到普适15；[Q05](#research-q05)统一调用省少量接线使简化4超无简化0，但角色/工具/权限/多状态与独立验收负担重，未到明显简化8。

business.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)提供协调登记/单次调用便利使workflow9，超无流程增量0，但任务assign/complete不自动执行/验代码，未到交接重组18；真实结果/usage归档与局部恢复使delivery8超只描述0，但未闭合独立软件验收到15；[Q01](#research-q01)CLI/MCP接口给已有开发者小幅触达5超只内部实现0，未证新客群/渠道10；[Q02](#research-q02)缓存hint、明确model/有条件替代候选与局部持久恢复改变资源安排，economics4超无机制0，但新增协调/外部调用和维护成本未测，未到8，未知ROI不作实测节费。

recommendation.reason: 已有多Agent软件任务的开发者先观察，只有在匹配构建、独立无敏感项目副本和私有受控stdio中，才值得后续以显式provider/model、零回退和小正有限输出核一项代表调用。它相对手工协调能统一登记、真实文本API和结果/部分恢复，但本链不是会自己执行工具再决策的代码Agent，也没有证明优于单Agent或原生Task的产物质量。身份、目录、状态/API/代码验收或费用/退出不明就停并人工读回，要求生产自主交付、多租户或硬资源回收者不能凭角色数/成功状态采用。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)、[Q05](#research-q05)已有协调需求及具体代表操作/产物验收明确，超泛Agent便利15；真实需求频次/净收益未测，未到30。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)统一登记/文本API与[Q03](#research-q03)局部恢复较纯手工有小幅便利6超0；本链缺自主工具/软件验收、单Agent/原生Task未对照，[Q04](#research-q04)弱标签不补质量，未到明确优势13。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)真实MCP/handler/provider/result和[Q03](#research-q03)停止/模式/文件反证、[Q04](#research-q04)真实hook与反馈caller超README/helper片段6；无构建运行/真实API或产物对照，未到19。

cost.rationale: [Q05](#research-q05)私有隔离、显式模型/零回退和人工读回给受控小样，超0；[Q03](#research-q03)多JSON/权限/物理退出与[Q04](#research-q04)弱反馈恢复负担重，真实TCO未知，未到10。

publication.summaries.text: 独立CLI/MCP工具平台，用项目内任务、Agent/模型登记、provider调用与状态记录辅助多Agent开发协调。

items.模型工具: stdio MCP登记/协调、单次provider文本调用和状态查询
items.用户命令: 根claude-flow/v3 CLI入口，构建dist需匹配
items.后台: 项目JSON状态/孤儿与局部锁、调用反馈及policy记录

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 用途 | 条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 任务/Agent登记 | 角色/模型/分配/结果状态 | 登记非进程；completed不验代码 |
| agent_execute | 真实provider文本API/usage | 本链无自主工具循环；有条件切模型/追加成本 |
| MCP接口/策略 | registry、广告与policy门 | 广告剪裁非allowlist，legacy/observe不等enforce |
| 状态恢复/观测 | 部分重读/孤儿/锁、API health | 非跨JSON事务/硬退出或代码正确率 |
| 条件mod/反馈 | Claude路由上下文/API弱标签 | 非DSH通用契约/校准概率/已证学习效果 |

publication.advice.text: 先观察，已有明确协调需求者最多在后续独立账户/隔离非敏感副本、匹配实际dist、私有受控stdio中核一项代表操作，并显式model/provider、小正有限输出和零fallback，不全开mods/neural/federation。分别核登记、API/stopReason、真实产物/测试和多文件状态，schema剪裁不当授权，task/agent stop不当请求/进程/外部动作撤回。身份、root、回执、费用或退出不清即停并人工读回，不能用本次单次文本接口承诺自主代码执行或生产多租户交付。见[Q05](#research-q05)。

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "<div align=\"center\">\n\n<a href=\"https://cognitum.one/agentic-engineering\"><img src=\"ruflo/assets/ruflo-neon-flicker.gif\" alt=\"Ruflo animated neon sign\" width=\"100%\"></a>\n\n**An agent meta-harness for Claude Code and Codex.**\n\n<!-- Try Ruflo — the 3 badges first-time visitors actually act on -->\n[![npm version (ruflo)](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/ruflo?label=npx%20ruflo&style=for-the-badge&logo=npm&color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ruflo)\n[![MIT License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow?style=for-the-badge)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)\n[![Star on GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/ruvnet/claude-flow?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&color=gold)](https://github.com/ruvnet/claude-flow)\n[![Follow @rUv on X](https://img.shields.io/badge/Follow-@rUv-000000?style=for-the-badge&logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://x.com/rUv)\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n<a href=\"docs/harness-origins.md\"><img src=\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ruvnet/ruflo/e69e4b95aa08d65ea0f7715489bbf8e62a83a0d2/docs/assets/readme/badges/first-commit.svg\" width=\"300\" height=\"76\" alt=\"Claude Flow lineage: first commit June 2, 2025 by rUv; inspect the evidence\"></a>\n<a href=\"data/npm-downloads.latest.json\"><img src=\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ruvnet/ruflo/275aff65a198af758923669acff36f03d1f41623/docs/assets/readme/badges/downloads.svg\" width=\"300\" height=\"76\" alt=\"Illustrative download counter starts at 98,000,000 and adds varied amounts each second in a 30 second loop. Verified dataset: 97,022,120 download events.\"></a>\n<br>\n<a href=\"https://github.com/ruvnet/claude-flow\"><img src=\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ruvnet/ruflo/d1e80400bdefe01d3b13e70395f88fffab76bb18/docs/assets/readme/badges/claude.svg\" width=\"300\" height=\"76\" alt=\"Claude Code plugin\"></a>\n<a href=\"https://www.npmjs.com/package/@claude-flow/codex\"><img src=\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ruvnet/ruflo/d1e80400bdefe01d3b13e70395f88fffab76bb18/docs/assets/readme/badges/codex.svg\" width=\"300\" height=\"76\" alt=\"Codex plugin\"></a>\n<a href=\"https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ab674ff53c48191bb37040c343e31f3\"><img src=\"docs/assets/readme/badges/chatgpt.svg\" width=\"300\" height=\"76\" alt=\"ChatGPT plugin: RuFlo Federation\"></a>\n</p>\n\n</div>\n\n<a id=\"start-here\"></a>\n\n## <img src=\"docs/assets/readme/icons/terminal.svg\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" alt=\"\"> Get started with Ruflo\n\n<img src=\"docs/assets/readme/icons/plugins.svg\" width=\"28\" height=\"28\" alt=\"\"> **Start in Claude Code** with core tools, the visual console and runtime mods. Requires Claude Code **2.1.287 or later**. Run inside Claude Code:\n\n```text\n/plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo\n/plugin install ruflo-core@ruflo\n/plugin install ruflo-console@ruflo\n/plugin install ruflo-mods@ruflo\n/reload-plugins\n/ruflo\n```\n\n**Core** provides foundation tools. **Console** opens the agent cockpit. **Mods** add routing and policy enforcement inside Claude Code. Mods run with your account's permissions; review their code before installing.\n\n<img src=\"docs/assets/readme/icons/terminal.svg\" width=\"28\" height=\"28\" alt=\"\"> **Using Codex or another MCP enabled tool?** Use NPX for Ruflo project setup and connect your client to the Ruflo MCP server. Run the setup wizard in your project terminal:\n\n```bash\nnpx ruflo@latest init wizard\n```\n\nFor clients that support local stdio MCP servers, configure **command** `npx` and **arguments** `[\"-y\", \"ruflo@latest\", \"mcp\", \"start\"]`. The equivalent server command is:\n\n```bash\nnpx -y ruflo@latest mcp start\n```\n\nMCP exposes Ruflo tools to your client. The console and mods above are Claude Code integrations; hook support depends on the client.\n\n<img src=\"docs/assets/readme/icons/terminal.svg\" width=\"28\" height=\"28\" alt=\"\"> **Prefer a plain terminal? Optional.** The console also runs on its own, with no Claude Code: `npx ruflo tui` (add `--plain` to print one frame for scripts). It shows Overview, Cost, Swarm, Events and Missions, plus an optional AI page. [Terminal UI guide](docs/USERGUIDE.md#terminal-ui-optional)\n\n<p align=\"center\"><img src=\"docs/assets/ruflo-tui-compact.svg\" width=\"640\" alt=\"Looping recording of the optional ruflo terminal UI with its pictures: Overview in the Classic BBS look, the Orbital look with its moving globe, and the Swarm graph, in a sample project\"></p>\n\n[Compare install paths](#quick-start) · [Open the console](#console-walkthrough) · [User guide](docs/USERGUIDE.md)\n\n<div align=\"center\">\n\n\n### Optional: ruOS Desktop\n\n<a href=\"https://ruos.cognitum.one\"><img src=\"ruflo/assets/ruos-animated.svg\" alt=\"ruOS — A desktop that runs itself\" width=\"100%\"></a>\n\n**Connect ruOS to ChatGPT or Claude via MCP:**\n\n```text\nhttps://ruos.cognitum.one/mcp\n```\n\n\n\n<!-- RuVector promo -->\n<a href=\"https://github.com/ruvnet/ruvector\"><img src=\"docs/assets/readme/ruvector-promo-depth.svg\" width=\"100%\" alt=\"RuVector: Give your agents memory. Local vector search, persistent context, graph relationships and feedback learning. Explore RuVector.\"></a>\n\n```bash\nnpx ruvector\n```\n\n\n\n\n# Ruflo\n\n[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)\n\n\n[![RuFlo Explained — build an AI team that plans, remembers, tests, and improves](docs/assets/ruflo-explained/ch14.jpg)](docs/ruflo-explained.md)\n\n**[📖 RuFlo Explained — Build an AI Team That Plans, Remembers, Tests, and Improves](docs/ruflo-explained.md)**\nA 14-chapter guide: from the basic idea to a first useful task, then memory, agent teams, plugins, cost and verification.\n\n</div>\n\n> **Agent = Model + Harness.** The model writes; the harness gives it tools, memory, loops, sandboxes, and controls so it can actually work. **Ruflo is the harness** — the execution layer around Claude Code and Codex that adds 100+ specialized agents, coordinated swarms, self-learning memory, federated comms across machines, and enterprise security guardrails. So agents don't just run, they collaborate.\n\nOne `npx ruflo init` gives Claude Code a nervous system: agents self-organize into swarms, learn from every task, remember across sessions, and — with federation — securely talk to agents on other machines without leaking data. You keep writing code. Ruflo handles the coordination.\n\n<p align=\"center\"><img src=\"docs/assets/readme/learning-cinematic-compact.svg\" width=\"100%\" alt=\"Ruflo trajectory learning: branching memory paths, outcome feedback, contrastive AI and local learning. No LLM required for local vector retrieval and contrastive updates; agent execution may still use an LLM.\"></p>\n\n<sub>Conceptual learning loop. Local vector retrieval and contrastive updates can run without an LLM; embeddings and configured learning modules are still required. See the <a href=\"v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/services/ruvector-training.ts\">RuVector training integration</a> and <a href=\"v3/@claude-flow/neural/src/modes/balanced.ts\">trajectory contrastive learning</a>.</sub>\n\n<details>\n<summary>Architecture in text</summary>\n\nUser → Ruflo (CLI/MCP) → Router → Swarm → Agents → Memory → LLM providers. Memory feeds useful experience back into routing. This is a conceptual flow, not a live execution trace.\n\n</details>\n\n> **New to Ruflo?** You don't need to learn 314 MCP tools or 26 CLI commands. After `init`, just use Claude Code normally — the hooks system automatically routes tasks, learns from successful patterns, and coordinates agents in the background.\n\n### An origin you can inspect\n\n[![Claude Flow to Ruflo: founding idea on June 2, 2025, orchestration source on June 10, and the continuing Ruflo lineage.](docs/assets/readme/harness-origins.svg)](docs/harness-origins.md)\n\n**Built by [Reuven Cohen (rUv)](https://github.com/ruvnet), originally as Claude Flow.** The [first commit, June 2, 2025](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/commit/7c1f9402d70e7af56c01a879073cbac92564dc4e), describes a code orchestration layer for recursive agent cycles: Claude writes, edits, tests and improves. The [June 10 source snapshot](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/tree/dba545f012ea92a2375a26332bbf3797495e93c9) adds orchestration, task scheduling, memory and terminal modules.\n\nA harness is the workbench around the model: it organizes tasks, carries context between steps and helps check results. **This establishes Ruflo's lineage, not a universal first across every Claude Code tool.** [See the illustrated explainer, exact commits and earlier ecosystem context](docs/harness-origins.md).\n\n**Grok Build:** `npx ruflo init --grok` writes the project host surface (`.grok/`, the team bus, and the operator guide) and nothing outside the project; add `--dry-run` to preview. Setup, the `spawn_subagent` contract, the optional status row, and what to re-check when Grok updates: [the Grok operator guide](v3/@claude-flow/cli/templates/grok/docs/README.md).\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>📖 Background — where the name comes from</strong></summary>\n\n> Claude Flow is now Ruflo — named by [`rUv`](https://ruv.io), who loves Rust, flow states, and building things that feel inevitable. The \"Ru\" is the rUv. The \"flo\" is working until 3am. Underneath, powered by [`Cognitum.One`](https://cognitum.one/?RuFlo) agentic architecture, running a supercharged Rust-based AI engine, embeddings, memory, and plugin system.\n\n</details>\n\n---\n\n<p align=\"center\"><img src=\"docs/assets/readme/console.svg\" alt=\"Mission control: inspect agent work\" width=\"100%\"></p>\n\n<p align=\"center\"><a href=\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ruvnet/ruflo/main/docs/assets/ruflo-console-theme-compact.svg\"><img src=\"docs/assets/ruflo-console-theme-compact.svg\" width=\"100%\" alt=\"Ruflo Orbital theme: animated boot checks, block logo, menu icons, rotating globe, swarm routing, six color palettes and responsive Theme Studio\"></a></p>\n\n[Open animated demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ruvnet/ruflo/main/docs/assets/ruflo-console-theme-compact.svg) · [Theme Studio guide](plugins/ruflo-console/README.md) · [Workflow demo](docs/assets/ruflo-console-workflows.svg)\n\n<img src=\"docs/assets/readme/console-icon-workflows.svg\" width=\"28\" height=\"28\" alt=\"\"> **Your agent cockpit.** Track workflows, agents, models, tokens and cost beside Claude Code. The 38 second animation shows **Orbital and Theme Studio** through actual renderer frames, including boot checks, six palettes, customization, saved themes, JSON import and resizing. This compact 3.84 MB SVG retains all 456 frames. Native host and AI provider execution are not demonstrated.\n\n<img src=\"docs/assets/readme/console-icon-inspect.svg\" width=\"28\" height=\"28\" alt=\"\"> **Inspect any run.** Open agent logs and results, search, triage failures, replay and compare. Start with `npx ruflo init`, restart Claude Code, then `/ruflo`. [Full console tour](docs/assets/ruflo-console-walkthrough-wide.gif).\n\n<img src=\"docs/assets/readme/console-icon-control.svg\" width=\"28\" height=\"28\" alt=\"\"> **Let Claude drive. You set the limits.** Enable **Settings → Claude control** to navigate and run console actions. Choose `read`, `write`, `manage` or `full`, with `ask` or `auto` approval. The current default is **read + ask**; raising the level is your choice. Actions above your permission level are refused, and network, spending and destructive actions require confirmation even in `auto`. Review the live action log or press **Take back control** to stop Claude control. [Details](v3/docs/adr/ADR-444-claude-controls-the-console.md).\n\n<a id=\"console-walkthrough\"></a>\n\n### One task: create a mission with Claude\n\n<img src=\"docs/assets/readme/console-icon-workflows.svg\" width=\"28\" height=\"28\" alt=\"\"> **Watch the recorded console session below.** Claude creates a mission, opens the Learning and Security pages, and reports its actions in Overview.\n\n1. **Set the boundary.** Install the console using the commands below, open `/ruflo`, then choose **Settings → Claude control → write + ask**.\n2. **Give a concrete request.** Try: “Create a mission to add a dark mode toggle. Show me the mission and its status.”\n3. **Approve creation.** Claude opens Missions and sets the goal. Confirm the pending create action in the console.\n4. **Verify the result.** Check that Missions contains the goal and Overview records the action. Creating a mission does not mean the feature has been implemented.\n5. **Keep control.** **Take back control** pauses Claude's console tools. A later call should be refused until you restore control.\n\n**What the recording demonstrates:** a real Claude Haiku session with `write + auto`, mission creation, page navigation, a refused swarm stop, and control being taken back. The steps above use `ask` so you approve creation yourself. The linked workflow animation uses sample data, while the theme demo replays renderer frames. Neither is evidence of completed swarm work or memory recall.\n\n[Implementation and recorded test findings](v3/docs/adr/ADR-444-claude-controls-the-console.md) · [Reproduction script](plugins/ruflo-console/scripts/e2e-control.sh)\n\n<p align=\"center\"><img src=\"docs/assets/ruflo-console-claude-control.gif\" alt=\"Claude Code with the ruflo console beside it: Claude sets a mission goal, creates the mission and opens the Learning, Security and Overview pages through the console tools; the Claude control dashboard logs each action; swarm-stop is refused because it needs the full level; the person clicks Take back control and the next request is refused\"></p>\n\n\n**Install the mods from the ruflo marketplace** (Claude Code 2.1.287 or later; mods run with your account's permissions and are not sandboxed, so read the code first):\n\n```text\n/plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo\n/plugin install ruflo-console@ruflo\n/plugin install ruflo-mods@ruflo\n/reload-plugins\n```\n\n`ruflo-console` is the cockpit above, `ruflo-mods` routes prompts and enforces policy in-process, `ruflo-swarm` shows the swarm in a pane, and `ruflo-ruos` adds the ruOS status segment. Open `/plugin` to confirm they appear in the active mods line. [Learning plugin](plugins/ruflo-intelligence/README.md).\n\n### Agent Federation — Slack for Agents\n\n<p align=\"center\"><img src=\"docs/assets/readme/federation.svg\" alt=\"Connected intelligence across machines\" width=\"100%\"></p>\n\n<p align=\"center\"><img src=\"docs/assets/readme/federation-flow.svg\" width=\"100%\" alt=\"Outbound agent, data filtering, signing and encryption, identity verification, input checks and receiving agent.\"></p>\n\nSlack gave teams channels. Federation gives agents the same thing — **shared workspaces across trust boundaries**, where agents on different machines, orgs, or cloud regions can discover each other, prove who they are, and collaborate on tasks.\n\nThe difference: some channels are trusted, some aren't. [`@claude-flow/plugin-agent-federation`](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/issues/1669) handles that automatically. Your agents join a federation, get verified via mTLS + ed25519, and start exchanging work — with PII stripped before anything leaves your node and every message auditable. Untrusted agents can still participate at lower privilege: they see discovery info, not your memory. As they prove reliable, trust upgrades. If they misbehave, they get downgraded instantly — no human in the loop required.\n\nYou don't configure handshakes or manage certificates. You `federation init`, `federation join`, and your agents start talking. The protocol handles identity, the PII pipeline handles data safety, and the audit trail handles compliance.\n\n> **📘 Full user guide:** [`docs/federation/`](./docs/federation/) — setup, MCP tools, trust levels, circuit breaker, and the (opt-in) WireGuard mesh layer that ties packet-layer reachability to federation trust. ADR-111 deep-dive at [`docs/federation/phase7-mesh-bringup.md`](./docs/federation/phase7-mesh-bringup.md).\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>Federation capabilities</strong></summary>\n\n| | Capability | How it works |\n|---|---|---|\n| 🔒 | **Zero-trust federation** | Remote agents start untrusted. Identity proven via mTLS + ed25519 challenge-response. No API keys, no shared secrets. |\n| 🛡️ | **PII-gated data flow** | 14-type detection pipeline scans every outbound message. Per-trust-level policies: BLOCK, REDACT, HASH, or PASS. Adaptive calibration reduces false positives. |\n| 📊 | **Behavioral trust scoring** | Formula (`0.4×success + 0.2×uptime + 0.2×threat + 0.2×integrity`) continuously evaluates peers. Upgrades require history; downgrades are instant. |\n| 📋 | **Compliance built-in** | HIPAA, SOC2, GDPR audit trails as compliance modes. Every federation event produces a structured record searchable via HNSW. |\n| 🤝 | **9 MCP tools + 10 CLI commands** | Full lifecycle: `federation_init`, `federation_send`, `federation_trust`, `federation_audit`, and more. |\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>Example: two teams sharing fraud signals without sharing customer data</strong></summary>\n\n```bash\n# Team A: initialize federation and generate keypair\nnpx claude-flow@latest federation init\n\n# Team A: join Team B's federation endpoint\nnpx claude-flow@latest federation join wss://team-b.example.com:8443\n\n# Team A: send a task — PII is stripped automatically before it leaves\nnpx claude-flow@latest federation send --to team-b --type task-request \\\n  --message \"Analyze transaction patterns for account anomalies\"\n\n# Team A: check peer trust levels and session health\nnpx claude-flow@latest federation status\n```\n\n</details>\n\nSee [issue #1669](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/issues/1669) for the complete architecture, trust model, and implementation roadmap.\n\n```bash\n# Claude Code plugin\n/plugin install ruflo-federation@ruflo\n\n# Or via CLI\nnpx claude-flow@latest plugins install @claude-flow/plugin-agent-federation\n```\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>Claude Code: With vs Without Ruflo</strong></summary>\n\n| Capability | Claude Code Alone | + Ruflo       "path": "plugins/ruflo-mods/hooks/register.ts",
      "content": "import type { Register } from 'claude-code'\n\nimport { registerAgents } from './agents'\nimport { registerCompact } from './compact'\nimport { registerCost } from './cost'\nimport { registerDelivery } from './delivery'\nimport { registerDescribe } from './describe'\nimport { registerGuard } from './guard'\nimport { createGuidance } from './guidance'\nimport { registerLearn } from './learn'\nimport { registerNoun } from './noun'\nimport { readOptions } from './options'\nimport { registerProbe } from './probe'\nimport { registerRollup } from './rollup'\nimport { registerRureOffer } from './rure-offer'\nimport { registerRoute } from './route'\nimport { registerSession } from './session'\nimport { createState } from './state'\nimport { registerTrust } from './trust'\n\n/**\n * ruflo as a Claude Code mod (ADR-404).\n *\n * In-process equivalents of the classic hook-handler.cjs events that fire on\n * every prompt and every edit, tighten-only tool checks, the cost ladder, the\n * `$.ruflo` noun other mods compose with, and the mod trust gate. Additive\n * and opt-in: the classic hooks stay the default, keep every event the mod\n * does not own, and take everything back whenever the mod is not loaded.\n *\n * Registration order is nesting order (the first registered wraps the rest):\n * the trust gate first, so it judges modules before anything else of ours runs.\n */\nexport const register: Register = (on, options) => {\n  const state = createState()\n  const opts = readOptions(options)\n  const guidance = createGuidance(state, opts)\n\n  registerTrust(on, opts.modTrust, opts.modTrustAllow)\n  if (opts.capabilityProbe) registerProbe(on, state, opts)\n  if (opts.sessionRollup) registerRollup(on, state)\n  state.grounding.enabled = opts.grounding\n  registerNoun(on, state)\n  registerSession(on, state, opts, guidance)\n  registerRoute(on, state, opts, guidance)\n  registerGuard(on, state, guidance)\n  registerLearn(on, state, guidance)\n  registerCost(on, state, opts)\n  if (opts.toolHints) registerDescribe(on, state)\n  if (opts.agentTrim) registerAgents(on, state, opts)\n  if (opts.deliveryScreen) registerDelivery(on, state)\n  if (opts.compactCarry) registerCompact(on, state)\n  if (opts.rureOffer) registerRureOffer(on, state)\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "plugins/ruflo-mods/hooks/route/index.ts",
      "content": "import type { On } from 'claude-code'\n\nimport { cachedFile } from '../files'\nimport type { GuidanceHooks } from '../guidance'\nimport type { ModOptions } from '../options'\nimport { redraw, under, type ModState } from '../state'\nimport { formatRoute } from './format'\nimport { parseRanked, rankedContext } from './ranked-context'\nimport { routeTask } from './route-task'\n\nexport const RANKED_PATH = '.claude-flow/data/ranked-context.json'\n\n/**\n * `prompt.submit`: hook-handler.cjs `route` in-process. The routing block\n * (and, with `routeContext`, the ranked-memory block) ride the prompt as\n * context the model reads and the user never sees: `prompt.submit` context is\n * the one injection point sec-default leaves to a person's plugins\n * (`prompt.context` is continued past the user tier).\n */\nexport function registerRoute(on: On, state: ModState, options: ModOptions, guidance?: GuidanceHooks) {\n  const ranked = cachedFile(() => under(state, RANKED_PATH), parseRanked)\n\n  on('prompt.submit', async ($, e, next) => {\n    const text = typeof e.text === 'string' ? e.text : ''\n    if (state.agentTrim.enabled) state.agentTrim.prompt = text.slice(0, 4000).toLowerCase() // agent.offer keeps a type the prompt names\n    const advisory = guidance ? await guidance.prompt(text, { stat: path => $.fs.stat(path), read: path => $.fs.read(path) }) : undefined\n    const context = [...(e.context ?? []), ...(advisory ? [advisory] : [])]\n    if (!state.owned.has('route')) return next(advisory ? { ...e, context } : e)\n    const result = routeTask(text)\n    state.lastRoute = result\n    state.routed++\n\n    const blocks: string[] = []\n    if (options.routeContext) {\n      const read = await ranked({ stat: path => $.fs.stat(path), read: path => $.fs.read(path) })\n      const context = read.kind === 'ok' ? rankedContext(text, read.value) : null\n      if (context) blocks.push(context)\n    }\n    blocks.push(formatRoute(text, result))\n    redraw(state)\n\n    return next({ ...e, context: [...context, blocks.join('\\n')] })\n  }).catch(($, e, next) => next(e)) // a broken plugin never blocks a prompt\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "plugins/ruflo-mods/hooks/route/route-task.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * The static keyword router, in-process.\n *\n * A hooks module may import nothing outside its plugin folder, so this is a\n * copy of `.claude/helpers/router.cjs` (TASK_PATTERNS, word-boundary\n * matching, first match wins). It is not a fork: the parity test in\n * `v3/@claude-flow/cli/__tests__/mods/route-parity.test.ts` fails CI when the\n * table or the matching drifts from router.cjs.\n *\n * The one deliberate difference is #3567: a prompt nothing matched says so\n * (`matched: false`, `reason: \"no-match-default\"`) and carries the\n * NO_MATCH_CONFIDENCE prior that `hooks_route` uses, never a real match's.\n */\n\nexport type RouteResult = {\n  readonly agent: string\n  readonly confidence: number\n  readonly matched: boolean\n  readonly reason: string\n}\n\n/** A real keyword match's heuristic prior (router.cjs, #2257). */\nexport const MATCH_CONFIDENCE = 0.6\n\n/** `NO_MATCH_CONFIDENCE` in cli/src/mcp-tools/hooks-tools.ts (#3567). */\nexport const NO_MATCH_CONFIDENCE = 0.3\n\nexport const TASK_PATTERNS: ReadonlyArray<{ readonly tokens: readonly string[]; readonly agent: string }> = [\n  { tokens: ['implement', 'create', 'build', 'add', 'write code', 'refactor', 'debug'], agent: 'coder' },\n  { tokens: ['test', 'tests', 'testing', 'spec', 'specs', 'coverage', 'unit test', 'integration test'], agent: 'tester' },\n  { tokens: ['review', 'audit', 'check', 'validate', 'security'], agent: 'reviewer' },\n  { tokens: ['research', 'find', 'search', 'documentation', 'explore'], agent: 'researcher' },\n  { tokens: ['design', 'architect', 'architecture', 'structure', 'plan'], agent: 'architect' },\n  { tokens: ['api', 'endpoint', 'server', 'backend', 'database'], agent: 'backend-dev' },\n  { tokens: ['ui', 'frontend', 'component', 'react', 'css', 'style'], agent: 'frontend-dev' },\n  { tokens: ['deploy', 'docker', 'ci', 'cd', 'ci/cd', 'pipeline', 'infrastructure', 'devops'], agent: 'devops' },\n]\n\nconst escapeRegex = (s: string) => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\\]\\\\]/g, '\\\\$&')\n\n/** router.cjs `buildPattern`: phrases literal, single tokens `\\b`-anchored. */\nexport function buildPattern(tokens: readonly string[]): RegExp {\n  const alternatives = tokens.map(tok => {\n    const escaped = escapeRegex(tok.toLowerCase())\n    return /\\s|\\//.test(tok) ? escaped : `\\\\b${escaped}\\\\b`\n  })\n  return new RegExp(`(?:${alternatives.join('|')})`, 'i')\n}\n\n// Compiled once per module load: the hot path is one regex test per entry.\nconst COMPILED = TASK_PATTERNS.map(entry => ({\n  agent: entry.agent,\n  reason: `Matched keyword(s) from: ${entry.tokens.join('|')}`,\n  regex: buildPattern(entry.tokens),\n}))\n\n/**\n * Routes a task description to an agent type.\n *\n * @param task the prompt text; anything else routes as no-match\n */\nexport function routeTask(task: unknown): RouteResult {\n  const text = typeof task === 'string' ? task.toLowerCase() : ''\n\n  for (const entry of COMPILED) {\n    if (entry.regex.test(text)) {\n      return { agent: entry.agent, confidence: MATCH_CONFIDENCE, matched: true, reason: entry.reason }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return {\n    agent: 'coder',\n    confidence: NO_MATCH_CONFIDENCE,\n    matched: false,\n    reason: 'no-match-default',\n  }\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "v3/@claude-flow/cli/bin/cli.js",
      "content": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n/**\n * @claude-flow/cli - CLI Entry Point\n *\n * Claude Flow V3 Command Line Interface\n *\n * Auto-detects MCP mode when stdin is piped and no args provided.\n * This allows: echo '{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",...}' | npx @claude-flow/cli\n */\n\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\nimport { readFileSync } from 'fs';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'url';\nimport { dirname, join } from 'path';\n\n// #2253 / #2256: Console filter installed BEFORE any other import. Two jobs:\n//\n// 1. Suppress the cosmetic \"[AgentDB Patch] Controller index not found\"\n//    warning from agentic-flow (it expects agentdb v1.x but we use v3).\n//    Tight match — must include BOTH the prefix AND the specific text;\n//    other [AgentDB Patch] messages flow through. Audit log\n//    audit_1776483149979 flagged a broader filter as too aggressive.\n//\n// 2. Redirect noisy stdout writes from upstream embedder libraries\n//    (ruvector ONNX loader, ruvector-onnx-embeddings-wasm parallel\n//    embedder) to stderr. Those libraries use console.log for progress\n//    messages — \"Loading model:\", \"  Downloading: …\", \"🚀 Initializing N\n//    workers\" — which corrupts MCP JSON-RPC stdio (#2253) and is noise\n//    on stdout. stderr is the right channel for progress to a TTY user,\n//    and the MCP stdio framer reads stdout only.\n//\n// This MUST be installed before `import('../dist/src/index.js')` so the\n// patch is in place before agentic-flow / ruvector load transitively.\nconst _origWarn = console.warn;\nconst _origLog = console.log;\nconst _origError = console.error;\n\n// #2726 — Some MCP clients place every advertised schema in every model\n// request. Keep \"all\" as the backwards-compatible default, but honor the\n// same category/namespace/exact-name selector as `mcp start --tools`.\nfunction _filterAdvertisedMcpTools(tools) {\n  const argv = process.argv.slice(2);\n  const toolsIndex = argv.findIndex((arg) => arg === '--tools');\n  const inlineTools = argv.find((arg) => arg.startsWith('--tools='));\n  const configured = process.env.CLAUDE_FLOW_MCP_TOOLS\n    || (toolsIndex >= 0 ? argv[toolsIndex + 1] : undefined)\n    || (inlineTools ? inlineTools.slice('--tools='.length) : undefined);\n  if (!configured || configured.trim().toLowerCase() === 'all') return tools;\n  const selectors = new Set(\n    configured.split(',').map((item) => item.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean),\n  );\n  if (selectors.size === 0) return tools;\n  return tools.filter((tool) => {\n    const name = tool.name.toLowerCase();\n    const category = typeof tool.category === 'string' ? tool.category.toLowerCase() : '';\n    return selectors.has(name)\n      || selectors.has(category)\n      || Array.from(selectors).some((selector) => name.startsWith(`${selector}_`));\n  });\n}\nconst _isCosmeticAgentdbPatchNoise = (msg) =>\n  msg.includes('[AgentDB Patch]') && msg.includes('Controller index not found');\nconst _STDERR_REDIRECT_PREFIXES = [\n  'Loading model: ',\n  '  Downloading: ',\n  '  Cache hit: ',\n  '  Disk cache hit: ',\n  'Model cache cleared',\n  '🚀 Initializing ',\n  '✅ ',\n];\n// agentdb's EmbeddingService.initialize() prints this cluster when\n// `@xenova/transformers` fails to load (commonly: macOS arm64 without\n// `brew install vips` — sharp can't resolve libvips). The warnings claim\n// agentdb is \"falling back to mock embeddings\", but memory-bridge.ts's\n// rescueAgentdbEmbedder swaps the embedder over to ruvector ONNX in\n// that exact case, so the user is NOT on mocks. The warnings are stale\n// and misleading; drop them. Match anchored to exact upstream prefixes\n// (agentdb/dist/controllers/EmbeddingService.js:48–56) so unrelated\n// warnings always flow through.\nconst _AGENTDB_MOCK_FALLBACK_DROP_PREFIXES = [\n  'Transformers.js initialization failed:',\n  '   Falling back to mock embeddings for testing',\n  '   This is normal if:',\n  '     - Running offline/without internet access',\n  '     - Model not yet downloaded',\n  '     - Network connectivity issues',\n  '   To use real embeddings:',\n  '     - Ensure internet connectivity for first',\n  '     - Or pre-download: npx agentdb',\n];\nconst _shouldRedirectToStderr = (msg) => {\n  for (const prefix of _STDERR_REDIRECT_PREFIXES) {\n    if (msg.startsWith(prefix)) return true;\n  }\n  return false;\n};\nconst _isAgentdbMockFallbackNoise = (msg) => {\n  for (const prefix of _AGENTDB_MOCK_FALLBACK_DROP_PREFIXES) {\n    if (msg.startsWith(prefix)) return true;\n  }\n  return false;\n};\nconsole.warn = (...args) => {\n  const head = String(args[0] ?? '');\n  if (_isCosmeticAgentdbPatchNoise(head)) return;\n  if (_isAgentdbMockFallbackNoise(head)) return;\n  _origWarn.apply(console, args);\n};\nconsole.log = (...args) => {\n  const head = String(args[0] ?? '');\n  if (_isCosmeticAgentdbPatchNoise(head)) return;\n  if (_shouldRedirectToStderr(head)) {\n    _origError.apply(console, args);\n    return;\n  }\n  _origLog.apply(console, args);\n};\n\n// #2256 fast path: --version / -V / --help / -h must NOT trigger heavy\n// imports (agentic-flow, ruvector ONNX, etc.) — those eagerly download a\n// 23 MB ONNX model on cold cache, blocking 60+ s and causing SIGTERM\n// under common timeout windows (npx default, MCP stdio 30 s). Resolve\n// version directly from package.json and exit before any heavy import.\n{\n  const _argv = process.argv.slice(2);\n  if (_argv.length === 1 && (_argv[0] === '--version' || _argv[0] === '-V')) {\n    try {\n      const __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\n      const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, '..', 'package.json'), 'utf-8'));\n      process.stdout.write(`ruflo v${pkg.version || '0.0.0'}\\n`);\n    } catch {\n      process.stdout.write('ruflo v0.0.0\\n');\n    }\n    process.exit(0);\n  }\n  // --help / -h with no other args also stays lightweight — fall through\n  // to the existing fast help path inside index.ts; we don't short-circuit\n  // here because some users pass `<command> --help` which needs lazy command\n  // loading. The version short-circuit is the only one safe to inline.\n}\n\n// Check if we should run in MCP server mode\n// Conditions:\n//   1. stdin is being piped AND no CLI arguments provided (auto-detect)\n//   2. stdin is being piped AND args are \"mcp start\" (explicit, e.g. npx claude-flow@alpha mcp start)\n//   3. EXCEPT — if the user explicitly passed --transport <non-stdio>\n//      (e.g. -t http), defer to the parser. Without this, every smoke\n//      test or non-TTY caller of `mcp start -t http` got force-routed\n//      into stdio mode and never hit the HTTP server (#1874 follow-up).\nconst cliArgs = process.argv.slice(2);\nconst isExplicitMCP = cliArgs.length >= 1 && cliArgs[0] === 'mcp' && (cliArgs.length === 1 || cliArgs[1] === 'start');\nconst explicitNonStdioTransport = cliArgs.some((a, i) => {\n  // -t <value> | --transport <value>\n  if ((a === '-t' || a === '--transport') && cliArgs[i + 1] && cliArgs[i + 1] !== 'stdio') return true;\n  // --transport=<value>\n  if (/^--transport=/.test(a) && !/^--transport=stdio$/.test(a)) return true;\n  return false;\n});\nconst isMCPMode = !process.stdin.isTTY\n  && !explicitNonStdioTransport\n  && (process.argv.length === 2 || isExplicitMCP);\n\n// `harness` observes the running system (it is the SessionStart hook), so it\n// skips normal CLI startup entirely: no daemon autostart, update check, policy\n// migration or config adoption, and no heavy imports. With --hook it fails\n// silently (no stack on stderr) so a missing dist/ can't disturb a session.\nconst isHarness = cliArgs[0] === 'harness' && !cliArgs.includes('--help') && !cliArgs.includes('-h');\n\nif (isHarness) {\n  const hook = cliArgs.includes('--hook');\n  try {\n    const { runHarnessCli } = await import('../dist/src/commands/harness.js');\n    process.exitCode = runHarnessCli(cliArgs.slice(1));\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (!hook) {\n      const missing = error && error.code === 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND';\n      console.error(`ruflo harness: ${missing ? 'the CLI is not built (dist/ is missing)' : (error && error.message) || error}`);\n    }\n    process.exitCode = hook ? 0 : 1;\n  }\n} else if (isMCPMode) {\n  // Run MCP server mode\n  const {       "content": "/**\n * Agent MCP Tools for CLI\n *\n * Tool definitions for agent lifecycle management with file persistence.\n * Includes model routing integration for intelligent model selection.\n */\n\nimport { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport { join } from 'node:path';\nimport { readRecordStore } from './record-store.js';\nimport { type MCPTool, getProjectCwd } from './types.js';\nimport { validateIdentifier, validateText, validateAgentSpawn } from './validate-input.js';\nimport { executeAgentTask } from './agent-execute-core.js';\nimport { AGENT_HEALTH_WINDOW, summarizeAgentExecutions, type AgentExecutionSample } from './agent-health-metrics.js';\nimport { pheromoneAgentEligibility } from './swarm-tools.js';\n\n// Storage paths\nconst STORAGE_DIR = '.claude-flow';\nconst AGENT_DIR = 'agents';\nconst AGENT_FILE = 'store.json';\n// #1916: hive-mind_spawn writes its workers to `.claude-flow/agents.json`\n// (a *different* file from the canonical `.claude-flow/agents/store.json`\n// used here). agent_status / agent_list / agent_logs merge that store so a\n// hive-spawned worker is resolvable instead of returning `not_found`.\nconst HIVE_AGENT_FILE = 'agents.json';\n\n// Model types matching Claude Agent SDK\ntype ClaudeModel = 'haiku' | 'sonnet' | 'opus' | 'opus-4.7' | 'inherit';\n\ninterface AgentRecord {\n  agentId: string;\n  agentType: string;\n  /** #4300 — display name given at spawn (`agent spawn --name`). */\n  name?: string;\n  status: 'idle' | 'busy' | 'terminated';\n  health: number;\n  taskCount: number;\n  config: Record<string, unknown>;\n  createdAt: string;\n  domain?: string;\n  model?: ClaudeModel;  // Tier label assigned to this agent\n  modelRoutedBy?: 'explicit' | 'router' | 'codemod' | 'default' | 'hybrid';  // ADR-026/143/149\n  /** ADR-149 — concrete picked model id (e.g. inclusionai/ling-2.6-flash). */\n  modelId?: string;\n  /** ADR-148 — execution provider hint. #2962 widened to include 'ollama'. */\n  provider?: 'anthropic' | 'openrouter' | 'ollama';\n  /** ADR-148 — concrete OpenRouter slug when provider='openrouter'. */\n  openrouterModel?: string;\n  lastResult?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  executionHistory?: AgentExecutionSample[];\n  /**\n   * ACOW — path to this agent's per-agent Copy-On-Write memory branch\n   * (agenticow), set only when the agent was spawned with `memoryBase`. On\n   * terminate the branch is promoted (merged to base) or discarded.\n   */\n  memoryBranch?: string;\n  /** ACOW — the shared base `.rvf` this agent's branch was forked from. */\n  memoryBase?: string;\n}\n\ninterface AgentStore {\n  agents: Record<string, AgentRecord>;\n  version: string;\n}\n\nfunction getAgentDir(): string {\n  return join(getProjectCwd(), STORAGE_DIR, AGENT_DIR);\n}\n\nfunction getAgentPath(): string {\n  return join(getAgentDir(), AGENT_FILE);\n}\n\nfunction ensureAgentDir(): void {\n  const dir = getAgentDir();\n  if (!existsSync(dir)) {\n    mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });\n  }\n}\n\nfunction loadAgentStore(): AgentStore {\n  return readRecordStore(getAgentPath(), 'agents', () => ({ agents: {}, version: '3.0.0' }));\n}\n\nfunction saveAgentStore(store: AgentStore): void {\n  ensureAgentDir();\n  writeFileSync(getAgentPath(), JSON.stringify(store, null, 2), 'utf-8');\n}\n\n// #1916: read hive-mind-spawned workers from `.claude-flow/agents.json`.\nfunction getHiveAgentPath(): string {\n  return join(getProjectCwd(), STORAGE_DIR, HIVE_AGENT_FILE);\n}\n\nfunction loadHiveAgents(): Record<string, AgentRecord> {\n  try {\n    const path = getHiveAgentPath();\n    if (existsSync(path)) {\n      const data = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, 'utf-8'));\n      if (data && typeof data.agents === 'object' && data.agents) {\n        return data.agents as Record<string, AgentRecord>;\n      }\n    }\n  } catch {\n    // Ignore — hive store is optional/best-effort.\n  }\n  return {};\n}\n\n/**\n * #1916: merged view of every tracked agent — the canonical agent store\n * plus hive-mind-spawned workers. On an id collision the canonical record\n * wins (it carries model-routing + lastResult that the hive store omits).\n */\nfunction loadAllAgents(): Record<string, AgentRecord> {\n  return { ...loadHiveAgents(), ...loadAgentStore().agents };\n}\n\n// Default model mappings for agent types (can be overridden)\nconst AGENT_TYPE_MODEL_DEFAULTS: Record<string, ClaudeModel> = {\n  // Complex agents → opus\n  'architect': 'opus',\n  'security-architect': 'opus',\n  'system-architect': 'opus',\n  'core-architect': 'opus',\n  // Medium complexity → sonnet\n  'coder': 'sonnet',\n  'reviewer': 'sonnet',\n  'researcher': 'sonnet',\n  'tester': 'sonnet',\n  'analyst': 'sonnet',\n  // Simple/fast agents → haiku\n  'formatter': 'haiku',\n  'linter': 'haiku',\n  'documenter': 'haiku',\n};\n\n// Lazy-loaded model router\nlet modelRouterInstance: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof import('../ruvector/model-router.js').getModelRouter>> | null = null;\n\nasync function getModelRouter() {\n  if (!modelRouterInstance) {\n    try {\n      const { getModelRouter } = await import('../ruvector/model-router.js');\n      modelRouterInstance = getModelRouter();\n    } catch (e) {\n      // Log but don't fail - model router is optional\n      console.error('[agent-tools] Model router load failed:', (e as Error).message);\n    }\n  }\n  return modelRouterInstance;\n}\n\n// ADR-149 — the cost-optimal neural router fires only when\n// `routeToModelFull(task, embedding)` is called with a real embedding. We\n// delegate to the shared task-embedder module (ADR-149 iter 9) so the\n// @xenova/transformers MiniLM pipeline + LRU cache are shared across\n// agent-tools and the agent-execute-core fallback path.\nasync function embedTaskSafe(task: string): Promise<number[] | undefined> {\n  const { embedTaskWithCache } = await import('../ruvector/task-embedder.js');\n  return embedTaskWithCache(task);\n}\n\n/**\n * Determine model for agent based on (ADR-026 3-tier routing):\n * 1. Fallback to sonnet\n */\nasync function determineAgentModel(\n  agentType: string,\n  config: Record<string, unknown>,\n  task?: string\n): Promise<{\n  model: ClaudeModel;\n  routedBy: 'explicit' | 'router' | 'codemod' | 'default' | 'hybrid';\n  canSkipLLM?: boolean;\n  codemodIntent?: string;\n  tier?: 1 | 2 | 3;\n  /** ADR-149 — concrete picked model id when the neural backend fired. */\n  modelId?: string;\n  /** ADR-148 — execution provider hint. #2962 widened to include 'ollama'. */\n  provider?: 'anthropic' | 'openrouter' | 'ollama';\n  /** ADR-148 — concrete OpenRouter slug when provider='openrouter'. */\n  openrouterModel?: string;\n}> {\n  // 1. Explicit model in config\n  if (config.model) {\n    const explicitModel = config.model as string;\n    if (['haiku', 'sonnet', 'opus', 'opus-4.7', 'inherit'].includes(explicitModel)) {\n      return { model: explicitModel as ClaudeModel, routedBy: 'explicit' };\n    }\n    // #2962 — a non-alias model string (e.g. an Ollama tag like\n    // 'qwen3.6:27b', or any other provider-native model id) is still an\n    // explicit user selection. Enhanced task-based routing with deterministic Tier-1 codemods\n  if (task) {\n    try {\n      // Try enhanced router first (includes codemod-intent detection)\n      const { getEnhancedModelRouter } = await import('../ruvector/enhanced-model-router.js');\n      const enhancedRouter = getEnhancedModelRouter();\n      // ADR-149 — embed the task so the cost-optimal neural backend fires.\n      // We probe the embedder lazily; if it can't load (no @xenova/transformers\n      // available), the enhanced router falls back to heuristic+bandit and\n      // the existing behaviour is preserved.\n      const embedding = await embedTaskSafe(task);\n      const routeResult = await enhancedRouter.route(task, { filePath: config.filePath as string, embedding });\n\n      if (routeResult.tier === 1 && routeResult.canSkipLLM) {\n        // Deterministic codemod can apply this edit ($0, no LLM)\n        return {\n          model: 'haiku', // fallback model if the codemod can't apply\n          routedBy: 'codemod',\n          canSkipLLM: true,\n          codemodIntent: (routeResult.codemodIntent ?? routeResult.agentBoosterIntent)?.type,\n          tier: 1,\n        };\n      }\n\n      // ADR-149 — forward the per-model fields. When the neural backend\n      // fired, modelId carries the cost-optimal pick (e.g. Ling); when\n      // it didn't, these are undefined and downstream behaviour is unchanged.\n      const routedBy: 'router' | 'hybrid' =\n        routeResult.routedBy === 'hybrid' ? 'hybrid' : 'router';\n      return {\n        model: routeResult.model!,\n        routedBy,\n        tier: routeResult.tier,\n        modelId: routeResult.modelId,\n        provider: routeResult.provider,\n        openrouterModel: routeResult.openrouterModel,\n      };\n    } catch {\n      // Enhanced router not available, try basic router\n      const router = await getModelRouter();\n      if (router) {\n        try {\n          // ADR-149 — embed the task so the cost-optimal neural backend\n          // fires (it's gated on `embedding && embedding.length > 0`).\n          // Without the embedding, route() falls back to heuristic+bandit\n          // and every per-model Pareto win the v2 measurement landed is\n          // invisible. embedTaskSafe returns undefined on any failure;\n          // route(task, undefined) behaves exactly as the prior code.\n          const embedding = await embedTaskSafe(task);\n          const result = await router.route(task, embedding);\n          // Map the routing mechanism to the broader agent-record taxonomy.\n          // 'hybrid' = neural prior + bandit blended (ADR-149); fold the rest\n          // into 'router' for back-compat with consumers reading modelRoutedBy.\n          const routedBy: 'router' | 'hybrid' =\n            result.routedBy === 'hybrid' ? 'hybrid' : 'router';\n          return {\n            model: result.model,\n            routedBy,\n            modelId: result.modelId,\n            provider: result.provider,\n            openrouterModel: result.openrouterModel,\n          };\n        } catch {\n          // Fall through to defaults on router error\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 3. Agent type defaults\n  const defaultModel = AGENT_TYPE_MODEL_DEFAULTS[agentType];\n  if (defaultModel) {\n    return { model: defaultModel, routedBy: 'default' };\n  }\n\n  // 4. Fallback to sonnet (balanced)\n  return { model: 'sonnet', routedBy: 'default' };\n}\n\nexport const agentTools: MCPTool[] = [\n  {\n    name: 'agent_spawn',\n    description: 'Spawn a Ruflo-tracked agent with cost attribution + memory persistence + swarm coordination. Use when native Task tool is wrong because you need (a) cost tracking per agent in the cost-tracking namespace, (b) cross-session learning via the patterns namespace, or (c) coordination with other agents in a swarm topology (hierarchical / mesh / consensus). For one-shot subtasks with no learning loop, native Task is fine. Pair with hooks_route to pick the right model first.',\n    category: 'agent',\n    inputSchema: {\n      type: 'object',\n      properties: {\n        agentType: { type: 'string', description: 'Type of agent to spawn (a legacy `type` key is accepted as an alias)' },\n        agentId: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional custom agent ID' },\n        name: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional display name for the agent (shown by agent_list, agent_status and ruflo-console)' },\n        // #2085 — accept swarmId so spawned agents register in the\n        // swarm.agents array that swarm_status reports. Omit to register\n        // with the most-recently-created swarm.\n        swarmId: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional swarm to register the agent with (defaults to most-recent swarm)' },\n        config: { type: 'object', description: 'Agent configuration' },\n        domain: { type: 'string', description: 'Agent domain' },\n        model: {\n          type: 'string',\n          enum: ['haiku', 'sonnet', 'opus', 'opus-4.7', 'inherit'],\n          description: 'Claude model alias (haiku=fast/cheap, sonnet=balanced, opus=current Opus 4.8, opus-4.7=prior Opus pin)'\n        },\n        task: { type: 'string', description: 'Task description for intelligent model routing' },\n        memoryBase: { type: 'string', description: 'Opt-in: base .rvf memory file to fork a per-agent Copy-On-Write branch from (agenticow). Requires the optional `agenticow` dep; degrades to a no-op when absent or when CLAUDE_FLOW_NO_COW_MEMORY=1.' },\n        memoryDimension: { type: 'integer', description: 'Vector dimension for the COW base (required only when memoryBase does not exist yet)' },\n      },\n      required: ['agentType'],\n    },\n    handler: async (rawInput) => {\n      // #4542: agent and command docs that `init` installed before 3.63.7 call\n      // agent_spawn with `type`. Accept it as an alias for `agentType`, and\n      // name the missing key ourselves: validateAgentSpawn maps agentType onto\n      // the security schema's `type` field and would report \"type: Required\".\n      let input = rawInput;\n      if (input.agentType === undefined && typeof input.type === 'string') {\n        const { type, ...rest } = input;\n        input = { ...rest, agentType: type };\n      }\n      if (typeof input.agentType !== 'string' || input.agentType === '') {\n        return { success: false, error: 'Input validation failed: agentType is required and must be a non-empty string (for example agentType: \"coder\")' };\n      }\n      // Validate user-provided input (#1425: wire security validators to runtime)\n      const validation = await validateAgentSpawn(input);\n      if (!validation.valid) {\n        return { success: false, error: `Input validation failed: ${validation.errors.join('; ')}` };\n      }\n\n      const agentId = (input.agentId as string) || `agent-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;\n      const agentType = input.agentType as string;\n      // #4300 — older callers (including `agent spawn` before this fix) send\n      // the name only as metadata.name.\n      const metadata = input.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;\n      const rawName = input.name ?? metadata?.name;\n      let name: string | undefined;\n      if (rawName !== undefined && rawName !== '') {\n        const vName = validateText(rawName, 'name', 200);\n        if (!vName.valid) {\n          return { success: false, error: `Input validation failed: ${vName.error}` };\n        }\n        name = vName.sanitized;\n      }\n      const config = (input.config as Record<string, unknown>) || {};\n\n      // Add explicit model to config if provided\n      if (input.model) {\n        config.model = input.model;\n      }\n\n      // Get task from either top-level or config (CLI passes it in config.task)\n      const task = (input.task as string) || (config.task as string) || undefined;\n\n      // Determine model using ADR-026 3-tier routing logic\n      const routingResult = await determineAgentModel(\n        agentType,\n        config,\n        task\n      );\n\n      // #2962 — an explicit, unambiguous provider choice in config wins over\n      // the router's own pick. 'anthropic' is deliberately excluded: the CLI's\n      // `agent spawn` action always sets config.provider (defaulting to\n      // 'anthropic' when --provider isn't passed — commands/agent.ts), so\n      // 'anthropic' here is indistinguishable from that silent default.\n      // 'ollama'/'openrouter' are never silently defaulted and are unambiguous.\n      const explicitConfigProvider =\n        config.provider === 'ollama' || config.provider === 'openrouter'\n          ? (config.provider as 'ollama' | 'openrouter')\n          : undefined;\n\n      const agent: AgentRecord = {\n        agentId,\n        agentType,\n        ...(name ? { name } : {}),\n        status: 'idle',\n        health: 1.0,\n        taskCount: 0,\n        config,\n        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        domain: input.domain as string,\n        model: routingResult.model,\n        modelRoutedBy: routingResult.routedBy,\n        ...(routingResult.modelId ? { modelId: routingResult.modelId } : {}),\n        ...(explicitConfigProvider\n          ? { provider: explicitConfigProvider }\n          : routingResult.provider ? { provider: routingResult.provider } : {}),\n        ...(routingResult.openrouterModel ? { openrouterModel: routingResult.openrouterModel } : {}),\n      };\n\n      const store = loadAgentStore();\n      store.agents[agentId] = agent;\n      saveAgentStore(store);\n\n      // #2085 — also push to the swarm store's agents array so that\n      // swarm_status reports the new agent. Without this, agent_spawn\n      // and swarm_status read/write separate stores and agents added\n      // post-init never show up in swarm_status.agents — confirmed for\n      // all topologies (hierarchical, mesh, etc.).\n      try {\n        const { loadSwarmStore: _loadSwarmStore, saveSwarmStore: _saveSwarmStore } =\n          await import('./swarm-tools.js');\n        const swarmStore = _loadSwarmStore();\n        let targetSwarmId = (input.swarmId as string) || '';\n        if (!targetSwarmId) {\n          // Default to the most-recently-created swarm.\n          const all = Object.values(swarmStore.swarms);\n          const latest = all.sort(\n            (a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime()\n          )[0];\n          targetSwarmId = latest?.swarmId || '';\n        }\n        if (targetSwarmId && swarmStore.swarms[targetSwarmId]) {\n          const swarm = swarmStore.swarms[targetSwarmId];\n          if (!Array.isArray(swarm.agents)) swarm.agents = [];\n          // Idempotent — don't duplicate if agent_spawn is retried.\n          if (!swarm.agents.includes(agentId)) {\n            swarm.agents.push(agentId);\n            _saveSwarmStore(swarmStore);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch { /* swarm store unavailable — agent still registered globally */ }\n\n      // Record agent in graph database (ADR-087, best-effort)\n      try {\n        const { addNode } = await import('../ruvector/graph-backend.js');\n        await addNode({ id: agentId, type: 'agent', name: agentType });\n      } catch { /* graph-node not available */ }\n\n      // ACOW — opt-in per-agent COW memory branch. Non-fatal: a branch failure never blocks the spawn —\n      // the agent is already registered above.\n      let memoryBranch: string | undefined;\n      if (input.memoryBase) {\n        try {\n          const { SwarmMemoryBranches } = await import('../services/swarm-memory-branches.js');\n          const svc = new SwarmMemoryBranches();\n          const br = await svc.branchForAgent(String(input.memoryBase), agentId, {\n            dimension: typeof input.memoryDimension === 'number' ? input.memoryDimension : undefined,\n          });\n          if (br.branchPath) {\n            memoryBranch = br.branchPath;\n            agent.memoryBranch = br.branchPath;\n            agent.memoryBase = br.basePath;\n            const latest = loadAgentStore();\n            const current = latest.agents[agentId];\n            if (current && current.status !== 'terminated') {\n              current.memoryBranch = br.branchPath;\n              current.memoryBase = br.basePath;\n              saveAgentStore(latest);\n            }\n          }\n          // else: degraded (agenticow missing / kill-switched) — agent stands\n          // without an isolated branch; callers see no memoryBranch field.\n        } catch { /* COW branch is best-effort; agent already registered */ }\n      }\n\n      // Include deterministic codemod routing info if applicable\n      const response: Record<string, unknown> = {\n        success: true,\n        agentId,\n        agentType: agent.agentType,\n        ...(agent.name ? { name: agent.name } : {}),\n        model: agent.model,\n        modelRoutedBy: routingResult.routedBy,\n        ...(routingResult.modelId ? { modelId: routingResult.modelId } : {}),\n        // #2962 — mirror the same precedence used for the stored agent\n        // record, so the response a caller sees matches what was actually\n        // persisted (previously this always reported the router's own\n        // pick, silently dropping an explicit config.provider override).\n        ...(agent.provider ? { provider: agent.provider } : {}),\n        ...(routingResult.openrouterModel ? { openrouterModel: routingResult.openrouterModel } : {}),\n        status: 'registered',\n        createdAt: agent.createdAt,\n        ...(memoryBranch ?
